config/results_metrics_v1.json: every v1 section, copied unchanged
does_not_establish: Realized results of past entries; not EV, an ROI forecast, a win probability, a calibration or a proven edge.
DraftKings gives a tie group its best place, so place / n flatters where ties are common; the random expectation assumes no ties.
Realized return on fees is a fact about past entries, never a model's ROI, an EV or a probability.
Payout shape and field size come from the numeric columns only; the contest name is never read.
The within-slate test was registered after its first 12 slates chose its direction; only later slates test it fresh.
First-place and top-1% finishes are rare at this volume; each count sits beside the sum of its entries' random shares, and each contest's best percentile is the reading with data.
Points behind first need each contest's winning score, which the export does not carry; Session 18's per-contest thresholds would supply it, and nothing here estimates it.

The random washout draws each contest's places independently and uniformly, with no ties and Places_Paid as given (a contest paying no place contributes 1); lineups shared across contests are part of what the realized rate is read against.

A portfolio is the paid entries sharing a contest start time and game type; Showdowns of different games that start at the same minute merge, because the export names no game and the contest name is never read.
